run_evaluation_cli: run the evaluate CLI tool to evaluate a pretrained MiniHack model on a Gymnasium environment
run_get_action: run get_action to infer the next action from a PolyBeast model given observations and hidden state
run_load_model: run load_model to load a pretrained PolyBeast model and its hidden state from a checkpoint directory
run_eval_episodes: run eval to evaluate a model over multiple episodes with optional GIF recording and rendering
run_main_parser: run main to parse CLI arguments and start model evaluation with configurable episodes, seeds, and render mode
